holdout.reason: Optional benchmarking stopped before holdout dispatch; no holdout agent was launched.

benchmarkGate.reason: Candidate build-3 was operator-interrupted and holdout was not run. The predeclared complete candidate gate is not established; report supports only the capability independently checked in completed trials.

limitations: Small local sample on one model and host; not a cross-framework benchmark. Delivery scope was narrowed after eight completed candidate passes; one active trial was interrupted and the holdout was not run.
Shared package caches, concurrent task campaigns, generic local skills, and sandbox permissions affect the measured experience.

A compatible registry release during the sample changed some candidate app frontend/backend resolutions from 0.1.65 to 0.1.66. CLI candidate archive/model/task settings stayed fixed; appVersions are recorded per run. This is not a strictly pinned installation comparison and supports no speed claim.

Trace audit observed no forbidden product/evaluator/other-run source access or installed-package edits unless recorded in traceBoundaryFindings; generic local skill access is disclosed. Some task-owned verification scripts/source snapshots were created in shared temporary directories outside the app despite app-only guidance; referenced paths are recorded, so filesystem isolation is not claimed.
Independent acceptance does not exhaust security cases or independently seed legacy/default-status behavior.

Usage retains CLI token accounting; no subscription dollar estimate. Interrupted candidate build-3 emitted no final usage; candidate totals cover eight completed turns and exclude its unreported consumption.
